title: Retraction notice to: Work–life balance and occupational stress among South African engineers: An examination of the mediating roles of perceived organisational support and job demands
abstract: Reason: The article, ‘Work–life balance and occupational stress among South African engineers: An examination of the mediating roles of perceived organisational support and job demands’, by Pretorius and Botha (2026), published online on 31 August 2026, has been retracted by the Editor-in-Chief and the Publisher because of unreliable findings.
